decisions.reason: Pre-reflow moisture control does not change the required handling or exposure of VRTC, VBACKUP, or PWROK.
Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not alter the through-hole assembly requirement for connectors.
The source establishes an AXP2101 manufacturing-process control but does not change the requested production-package revision, BOM, component positions, or quotation purpose.
The moisture-control measure does not change the AXP2101 selection, required rails, simultaneous charging behavior, or battery-efficiency goal.
The identified component-moisture issue does not change high-current net widths, copper-pour continuity, or stitching-via requirements.
Pre-reflow baking does not change the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
The AXP2101 assembly-process correction does not alter any display-backlight circuit requirement.
Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not change the placement rule or identified set of local decoupling capacitors.

The source identifies an assembly cause and corrective manufacturing process, but the required steady 3.3V DCDC1 output remains unchanged; implementation or test status must not be propagated as a MODIFY.
AXP2101 moisture control does not affect the button and switch pull-up topology or active-LOW behavior.
The source does not revise the component-tier preference, connector-reduction strategy, sourcing exception, or broader cost goal.
The AXP2101 pre-reflow process does not change PIR or touch input biasing and signal behavior.
